terms.definition: A number from 0 to 1 measuring how likely an event is.
terms.function: 0 is impossible, 1 is certain, 0.5 is an even bet.
terms.whereItIs: The reading on the chance scale.
terms.whyItMatters: Probability is chance turned into a number you can use.

terms.definition: Scenarios where each outcome has the same chance.
terms.function: Four equal sectors make each outcome 1/4.
terms.whereItIs: The four equal sectors of the spinner.
terms.whyItMatters: Equal sectors make the math fraction clean.

terms.definition: The designed 1/4 vs. what trials actually produce.
terms.function: Many trials bring the experiment near the theory.
terms.whereItIs: The trial chart converging on the scale.
terms.whyItMatters: Experiments verify the numbers you calculate.

terms.definition: The two ends of the chance scale — 0 and 1.
terms.whereItIs: The ends of the scale bar.
terms.whyItMatters: Knowing the bounds keeps two fractions from going astray.
